description: Stores a prepared change in the local APPROVAL QUEUE (~/.suunto-mcp/approvals.json, SUUNTO_APPROVALS_PATH moves it; version 1, written atomically, 0600) so the user can decide on it later. It writes only that file, never contacts Suunto and NEVER pushes anything to the watch: nothing is pushed unless the user approves with resolve_approval (decision approve AND push: true in the same call). `kind` 'adjusted_guide': `payload` is the exact push_strength_guide arguments (an adjust_guide result's `guide`; a guideId is refused, an approval only creates a new guide); kind 'week_plan': `payload` is { guides: [...] } as push_week_plan takes them (a propose_next_week result's `guides`). The payload is checked as the push tool itself checks it (its input schema, then building each guide as a dry run), and a payload that would not pass is refused and nothing is stored. `forDate` is the day of the guide (the earliest guide's for a week_plan): leave it out, or pass exactly that date. A guide dated before today is refused, in a week_plan too. Optional `reasons` (up to 20 short strings shown to the user), `source` (e.g. 'adjust_guide', 'propose_next_week'; default 'manual') and `expiresAt` (ISO 8601; default the end of forDate in the server's local time; it can be earlier, never later: an approval cannot outlive the day it is for; it cannot be approved after it expires). Pass a `queuePayload` from propose_next_week or adjust_guide as it is. Output: { queued, approval: { id (a1, a2, ...), kind, status 'pending', forDate, source, createdAt, expiresAt, reasons, resolution: null }, note }. At most 1000 approvals; nothing is deleted automatically. Every writer of the file (this tool and resolve_approval, a push included) runs one at a time in this process, so none can erase another's record; a second server process writing in the same moments could still collide.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 moment after which the approval can no longer be approved; not later than the end of forDate (server local time), which is the default.

forDate.description: Optional: must equal the guide's own date (the earliest guide's for a week_plan), which is the default.

kind.description: adjusted_guide: one strength guide (push_strength_guide's arguments). week_plan: { guides } (push_week_plan's guides).

payload.description: The exact arguments of the push tool: for adjusted_guide a strength guide spec (title, date, exercises, ...); for week_plan { guides: [strength guide specs] }.

reasons.description: Why this change, in short sentences, shown with the approval.

source.description: Where the change came from, e.g. 'adjust_guide' or 'propose_next_week'. Default 'manual'.

name: queue_adjustment
title: Queue a prepared change for the user's approval (local file, pushes nothing)
